content: Amisye Apa anakotaro Po rave aneno Israel mai mbe ananyaobe wansai

content.text: Inya, sya kawasae weap, wasamarikoame rasakinav de sya ananyao so rai,
wapo rinaranivo sya ana idaura so rai.
Syare syo ananeneae mbe ananyaobe raura,
muno syo anakotaro ngkokaibe no arono wusyine inta raura.
Namirati reama aneno sinane wo rarire reansai ti,
reamo ranaun muno no reansai,
omamo reamo inta rangkokaibe irati reama arikainye mansai ramu.
Yara reamo rarire indamu arikainyo mbeakaseo akato nawamo,
wo AMISY Apa vambunine muno Apa ana dave makokoive,
muno Apa ana dave mbe anaanibe ranaun.
Wepi Po Apa ananyao raugaje ntami vatano Israel mai,
muno Po Apa anaparatote raunande Yakop apa susye umaso mai.
Po reama aneno sinane matutir
indamu wo veano awa arikainye manyao.
Indamu awa arikainyo mbeakaseo akato wo raen,
onawamo arikainyo nanawirati mavaki rainye nao,
ubeseo wo rarire irati awa arikainye mai akato.
Wirati awa anave ransaroro Amisye obo Ai,
muno vemo manimari Amisye Apa anakotaro Po rave rai jinya,
yara ubeta Apa ananyao obo rai tutir.
Indamu vemo wo awa aneno wusyine mansamaisy inya,
nanawirati wonae ubeta Amisye Ai, muno usarirae ti umarovave Ai.
Aneno susye umaso nawamo manuga ntindimu Amisye Ai jewen,
muno matawandi utavondi Aije ramu.
Naito susyo Efraim wo apae atoe raijar,
weramu usarirae ti unanajibe arono usisa marova rai.
Onawamo usayae matuve urairi Amisye Po raokae nande mai raije ramu,
muno wonae ubeta Apa anaparatote raiji.
Onawamo manimarijo Apa anakotaro Po rave mai to rai,
muno anakotaro mbe anainambe namirati Po rarorono mai to rai tavon.
No awa anene mansamun, Amisye Po anainame rarorono mai,
no munijo Mesir, nai anoko Soan.
Po Mayano Kolsum raporar ti mansop, Po maugavo ama yasyine raito,
mana umaso mamo Po ranoka ti ntet maisyare peno nteto rani rani ramaisy.
Apa kamuro kaipoe mirati mo mansaugavo unanui raito arono sansimane rai,
muno taname mi mbaro mai no arono naman.
Wepi Po oramo akoe raporar no anoko kanen,
muno Po mana raunanto wo ramanam omamo Po raveti manakoe, maisyare waro nggwaro rave wemaisy.
Po mana raveti muje no unato orame rai,
muno Po raveti njam maisyare mana akoe wemaisy.
Weramu nai anoko kanen onawamo wonae ubeta Amisy Titi Rave Aiji,
wo ayao kakai rave tutiro Ai.
Wo Amisye atopano awa ana udatantona no manuga rai,
wo atan no anaisyo ubekedai rai.
Wo Amisye aura tantunawi, ware:
“Amisye pamo indati mamaisyo Po anaisye raunande wandaisy no anoko kanene so aje rako?
Wamo raen to, Po oramo akoe ranepat,
ti mana nsui uje rai, muno njam anyi.
Weramu indati mamaisyo Po anaisyo roti me, maere me ratayao da
Po raunande Apa kawasae reansai jaje rako?’’
Arono AMISY Po awa ayao wo rakere so ranaun, Opamo parijo mai rave,
Po taname raugaje ti mo vatano susyo Yakop mansanen,
muno anuga ntatupamijo kawasae Israel umaso mai.
Weye wanave Amisye Ai jakato ramu,
muno mansanaveano amene ramu, ware Opamo bambunin da Po mapaya kakai rai jewen.
Weramu Po naume warae ratutir,
indamu ama unsanda nsaneka anyi,
umba Po anaisyo manna raugaje ti wo raisy,
anaisyo manna so ntuna no munijo ntiti umba Po raugaje mai.
Vatane umaso wo anaisyo naito Amisy wo raisye so raisy tavon,
muno anaisyo Amisye Po ratayao mansamarome umaso mamo Po ratayao ti manui rave.
Po ovaro wanamurame atutir ti puje no naume warae,
muno Apa vambunine veano ovaro wanampui atutir ti tipu.
Po ovare umaso aveano insani maugav ti nde mansai manui rave, ti ratore kakai,
muno ama manuije maisyare nayavo ntuna no mayane vone wemaisy.
Po insani umawe raveti ntatayaje no varodoro utantuna ri we rai janyi,
ti mo awa randumo una rai rayapu kijani tenambe.
Amisye Po awa bekere raunande mai ti mamaisyo mai,
ti wo raisya uman to.
Weramu arono uman dave rainy,
yara ta wo raisya nene,
arono naije Amisye anuga mamun ti pari mai rave.
Weti Po vatano ubambunin ti upapirabe no Israel maubaisy,
muno Po arikainyo baribuai Israel mansanave mamene maubaisy.
Maisyare omai damu wo ayao kakai rave tutir,
muno wanave Amisye Apa anainamo Po rarorono mai rai ramu.
Maisyare omai ti Amisye Po awa matame raotar aje tumaimbe vayave ti makanive maisyare ovar bayave,
muno tumo wo raijakaseo mamo una irati yanive ama uga rai.
Arono Amisye Po inta maubaisy umba kaije usarirae ti wo akani wakare Ai jakato,
usarirae wakare Ai manuga ntenami rautan.
Naije umba mansaemen akare ware Amisye Wepirati unato oram mansamamavube Ai pije,
muno Obo pi rati Amisy Titi Rave, Po mansapaya kakai rai.
Weramu onawamo wo apamponae,
ayao aarurijate mi wo rator nanto Ai.
Manuga nsarokir da no tawano Ai jewen,
muno Apa urairi Po raokae nande mai mamo wo raijaro matuve ramu.
Weramu Opamo aemeno mai tutir,
Po mapaya irati awa ayao kakai rai,
muno Po maubai da makanive jewen.
Atawandi Apa parije rai tutir bayave,
muno Apa pari mangke mamo Po rangkumi ti Po raude mai ramu.
Opamo aemeno mansai weye onawamo vatan bayave nao ti,
maisyare ovaro ta deto ti akanive ti pakare jewene wemaisy.
Abo! Arono nai anoko kanen onawamo wonae tutiro ubeta Aiji,
muno wo aveti anuga ranimaumbe, arono una no anoko kanen umaso.
Wo Amisye atopan tutir bayave,
wo Amisy Dandinit, Israel taune ubeaje Ai, aveti anuga njoramo mai.
Wo Apa vambunine ratantona ramu,
namirati arono Po veano mapaya irati awa marova mai wem.
Arono Po anainame raroron anyi no munijo Mesir,
muno anapaporainyo Po rave no anoko Soan.
Purarijato awa mana rai ti mbe mavuve,
weti wo ramaname mamo mamaisye jewen.
Po abuu manui ratutiro mai ti mo mansayapu muno mo mansatatao,
muno Po kunaije raveti mo anare munije we raisy ti mewen.
Po ao ratande ti mo awa anare raisy,
muno nawaisye ama ine mamo kao mine wo raotar ti mewen.
Po maru orame raveti maje awa anare anggurije rai ti mo rakupi,
muno inyo ara mamo Po maru es raude rai ti nsamondak.
Po maru orame raveti maje tavon irati awa maero makume mai,
muno Po ivake ratukande tavon ti mo awa maero makume maubaisy.
Po Apa parijo mamoane rapaya aje mai,
pari me, siurije me yaude kava,
maisyare naito wene inta maroyaro mai wemaisy.
Opamo atawandi jakato Apa parije rai ramu,
muno wene mamo Po mapaya rai akato jewen,
yara Po waneno mangke raude ratutumbe mai kobe.
Po arikainyo ananuiny Mesir mansao bintabo,
wenawamo arikainyo mavaki anuive no yavaruga Mesir rai janyi nao.
Po vatano Israel mansaugav wusya maisyare maero domba maugave wemaisy,
Po maugav wanya no anoko kanen maisyare domba maugave wemaisy.
Po maugavo mavabe ti una kovo saumane rai muno ujanive jewen,
yara awa marova nawamo Po makuvu asyo no mayane ate.
Po mansaugav usisa no kopa taune Apa ura raije rai,
ude no unato taune Apa vambunine veano raugav amarome rai.
Arono usisa no kopa so rai, Po susyo ntuna rai mawatano marambe mai.
Umba Po muni umaso raosoro Israel mai indamu awa ura rai tutir.
Muno Po susye umaso awa munije raunande susyo Israel mai tenambe indamu utantuna rai.
Weramu wonae ubeta Amisy Titi Rave Ai, muno wo atopan,
muno wo Apa ananyao raijaro matuve jewen.
Onawamo matawandi utavondi Amisye Ai jakato jewen, yara makirive Ai, maisyare awa aneno sinane mansamaisy.
Muno mansanuga nsarokiro Ai jakato jewen maisyare apae moto ngkavine wemaisy.
Wo Amisye aveti anuga njoramo mai rave,
weye wo tewa orame ranarijo awa yare mansamarom no unate rai janyi,
muno wo aveti anuga mamuno mai weye ubeaje yare obo mai.
Amisye Po Israel awa ubetaije maisye raen,
weti pari rave muno ponae mai rave kobe.
Po Apa randumo tuna rai no Silo
rapaya ti ntami,
omamo randumo de tuna
rai no vatano mine so awa yasyin.
Kasyamo Urairi omirati Apa kovo ntiti raeno rai,
omamo aneme mpaya rai ti marova wo raugav.
Pari Apa kawasae taune Po matayao terave amarome umaso mai ti,
Po mapaya ti awa marova wo maotaro omake rai.
Awa arikainyo anya baribuai nawamo marova mo maunto ti mewen,
weti wanya kamurame inta ubauname ramu ti ransyerano vauname inta ranaun akatoe jewen.
Awa syene nawamo marova wo maotaro omake rai,
weti awa wanya ube kavinive, weramu woyovo mai kakai.
Weti umba Akoe beseo kobe, maisyare vatano niki ti beseo kai wemaisy,
maisyare anaanivo po angguri ramanam ti mo vambunine raugavo ai wemaisy.
Weti Po Apa marova manepat ti wansuk akiri muno unanajibe,
muno Po mapinde ti awa tame ngkakai
ntoa nuge nuganui.
Ponae irati Yusup apa ajavi mai,
onawirati Epraim apa susye nao,
muno Po matayao akato ramu.
Yara Po susyo Yehuda obo matayao terave akato amarom,
muno anuga no unato Sion rai indamu tuna rai.
Po Apa Yavaro ndandinit rauseo nteto tindimuve,
maisyare naumo ntiti me mine so me no tindimuve ntoa nuge nuganui wemaisy.
Po Daud wepi vatano panapatambeo Ai atayao,
umba Po augav no apa anakero po maero domba mansayaranande rai.
LuPo augav no apa anakero po domba akoe me tuvane me makume rai,
indamu be akarive kawasae Israel
mai muno po mansayaranande,
weye onawirati kawasae Amisye taune Po matayao terave amarom.
Daud po mansayaranande anuga nsarokire rai,
muno po mansaugavo mavabe unanui ngkove rai.

footnotes.text: Aneme so ratoe akato no Mat. 13:35.
Israel onawamo Yakop apa susyo po mampame naowa.
Anoko Soan no no mana akoe Nil ama ranijo wanamuram.
Anoko Soan no no mana akoe Nil ama ranijo wanamuram no munijo Mesir.
Ayao Ibrani maisyare so: ‘‘yavaruga Ham.’’ Munijo Mesir rawain tavonamo ‘‘munijo Ham,’’ weye Nuh apa arikainyo Ham muno apa susyo po mampame una no naije.
Kuruno Ayao Amisy inta wo ratantona ware unate so omamo Unato Sion, yara kuruno kaijinta ware unate somamo unato ntuna anyi no munijo Israel.

Apa randumo tuna rai no Silo: omamo randumo manasyino Kasyamo Urairi ntuna rije, arono Yavar Amisy Yerusalem rauseo nte dainy. Kasyamo Urairi umaso mamo Harun apa isyo me, orame vasye jirum Anaparatot Amisy ratoe yai muno vabiu anaisyo manna raveasyo ntuna rai omirati ntuna uga rai.
randumo de tuna rai: omamo Kasyamo Urairi mirati ntuna rai, mbe rarorombe Amisye de no mansatavon.
Ayao Ibrani maisyare so: ‘‘taname mo mansanen ti makanive.’’
woyovo mai kakai: ama ine mare Israel wo marova rave tutir weti wo awa koke rantuna omamo mangkeo mai, muno naito mamune usoowato mai ti wanya kavini woyove kakai.
Susyo Epraim una no munijo Israel ama ranijo wanansai, yara susyo Yehuda una no ranijo wanampui.
Unato Sion omamo no no munijo akoe Yehuda.
Israel: Ayao Ibrani mo ‘‘Yakop’’ ratoe. Susyo Yakop ama ine mare kawasae Israel, weye aneno Yakop awain tavonamo ‘‘Israel.’’
